library.scope: Captured layer77 rank0 BF16 projections, full CPU FP64 oracle. Direct mode uses raw HIP module dispatch, inline160B ABI GSU1. Library mode uses PyTorch BLAS preferences. Graph timings exclude interpreter and TP; not HSA runtime or model qualification.

direct.scope: Captured layer77 rank0 BF16 projections, full CPU FP64 oracle. Direct mode uses raw HIP module dispatch, inline160B ABI GSU1. Library mode uses PyTorch BLAS preferences. Graph timings exclude interpreter and TP; not HSA runtime or model qualification.

hsa.scope: Direct Plow C HSA backend, full outputs exact vs qualified HIP output, three reuses and 512B guard; not Rust adapter or full-model qualification.

capture.prompt_strategy: One seed-0 random row of token IDs 1..9, cycled over all 20 slots to stay below the execve argument limit.
capture.scope: Diagnostic opcode attribution and projection captures; repeated prompts and tracing are not serving performance evidence.

portable_source_normalization.check: Python AST exact equality; only formatting changed after GPU run

limitations: The repeated-prompt capture is diagnostic, not the random serving workload.
Standalone GEMV excludes persistent interpreter register pressure, prefetch, scheduling and TP.
Native decode integration is opt-in and pending full-model quality and matched serving qualification.

full_model_retrieval.scope: FP8-KV full78layer TP8 model; limited retrieval correctness, not broad model quality or throughput qualification.

serving.scope: Single paired 20-request screen, on then off, exclusive 8x MI300X lease. No CPU compilation or other GPU experiments during either arm. No speculative decoding. Does not establish repeatability, broad quality, or parity with the 100-request H200 reference.

source.scope: 18 retrieval C20 then 20 random70k/700 ratio.14 C20 seed0 per arm, same runtime and GPU objects. On first. No speculation.

serving.recipe:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-b20-gemm
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- on off; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO=/tmp/tp-glm53-fp8-b20/overlay
    "$root/plowrt" serve --assets "$root/assets-$arm" --port 18990 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18990/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18990 "native-gemm-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 20 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18990 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done
serving.decision: Keep glm_gemm_lt_decode opt-in false: throughput and mean TPOT improve in this screen, but P99 TPOT regresses and repeatability/broad quality remain unqualified.
